scenes.name: tomy/beat
scenes.ovoz: Once upon a time, in a sleepy green valley, lived a little robot named Tomy.

scenes.name: tomy/beat
scenes.ovoz: Beep boop! Systems on! Good morning, world!

scenes.name: tomy/beat
scenes.ovoz: Tomy loved mornings. So off he rolled, to explore.

scenes.name: tomy/beat
scenes.ovoz: He waved to the birds. He waved to the clouds.

scenes.name: tomy/beat
scenes.ovoz: But the sun grew hot. Very hot. And there, all alone, stood a tiny flower.

scenes.name: tomy/beat
scenes.ovoz: Oh no! Little flower, you look so thirsty!

scenes.name: tomy/beat
scenes.ovoz: Don't worry! I have just the thing, right here in my head!

scenes.name: tomy/beat
scenes.ovoz: Tomy poured every drop, slowly and carefully.

scenes.name: tomy/beat
scenes.ovoz: Wow! Thank you, Tomy! I feel brand new!

scenes.name: tomy/beat
scenes.ovoz: Every single day! That's what friends are for!

scenes.name: tomy/beat
scenes.ovoz: And so, they became best friends. Because a little kindness makes everything grow.
